name: assert-api-nested-object-match
description: assertApi's body assertion passes when the expected value is a nested object that deep-equals the captured value, proving a script-parsed OrderedMap compares correctly against the captured plain map
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: assert api nested object match
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "GET /api/user as: userRsp"
- assertApi:
    from: userRsp
    body:
      "$.user":
        id: 1
        name: Ann
